morphology.pattern_note: 不是马来语派生词；保留输入小写词头，正常行文写作 Cheryl。IPA 列出英语人名的两种词典读音，实际称呼以本人读法为准。[Oxford：Cheryl](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cheryl)

senses.zh_definition: 谢丽尔；通常为女性名字。中文译写可因本人惯用姓名而异。
senses.en_definition: Cheryl, a feminine given name used in English-speaking contexts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang perempuan yang digunakan dalam lingkungan berbahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不是具有普通词义的马来语通名；在马来语句子中仍通常保留原拼写。下列为自然称呼组合，不能视为固定搭配或据此推断其使用频率。[Oxford：Cheryl](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/cheryl)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Puan Cheryl akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Cheryl 女士将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Ms Cheryl will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Cheryl dah sampai, dia tunggu kat bawah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Cheryl sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu di bawah.
dual_scenarios.zh: Cheryl 到了，在楼下等着呢。
spoken_features: 以并列短句传递即时消息

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Cheryl dah sampai ke? Aku nak turun sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Cheryl sudah tiba? Saya hendak turun sekarang.
messages.zh: Cheryl 到了吗？我现在要下楼了。
messages.en: Is Cheryl here yet? I'm heading downstairs now.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat lobi je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba. Dia sedang menunggu di lobi.
messages.en: Yes, she's here. She's waiting in the lobby.

etymology.historical_story: Cheryl is generally explained as an elaboration of Cherie, possibly influenced by Beryl. Name histories describe it as rare before the twentieth century and associate its American popularity with actress Cheryl Walker. These are accounts of an English given name, not evidence of a Malay root or a literal Malay meaning. [Behind the Name：Cheryl](https://www.behindthename.com/name/cheryl)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 将 Cheryl 与具体的人和她自报的读音绑定记忆；ch 可读 /ʃ/ 或 /tʃ/，不要直接套用马来语 c 的读法。
